text: {"kind":"final","content":"{\"answer\":\"Root Route's tools don't hold that. They cannot provide an estimate of how many points the routing vendor's engine would add to Halcyon's on-time rate. The tools can show instead: the current on-time rate versus the 94% benchmark, penalties and handling costs, counts of late deliveries and how many are due to each of the five causes (incomplete address, order after the cut-off, non-nearest warehouse, carrier lane, route detour), the replayed effect of fixing causes before pickup and of carrier lanes and routing choices, which carrier lanes Root Route blocks and why, carrier on-time rates on fair data for lanes, carrier D's Friday cap, which carrier Root Route would book for a specific order and its backup, the delivery promise cut-off logic, and diagnostics about route overruns. If you want one of those figures or a replay comparison between fixing causes before pickup and improving carrier lanes/routes, tell me which report to run and for which segment (all, email, at_risk, or a region).\",\"refused\":true}"}
